title: Current-view infrastructure perception interface
objective: Return reviewable detections tied to the exact requested image.

accepted_result_states.meaning: The exact current panorama frame was processed and one or more class-coloured detections are displayed on that same view.
The exact current panorama frame was processed successfully and the active model retained zero supported detections.
The current panorama frame could not be acquired or processed; the response names the technical reason and never substitutes another image.

providers.credential_handling: The browser key is held in tab memory, passed only for the current local inference request, excluded from logs and never persisted.
providers.pixel_handling: The requested frame is temporary, hashed for audit identity and deleted immediately after inference.

frame_request.inference_strategy: Exact-view full frame plus generic road-band localisation and versioned heterogeneous high-recall proposal fusion; no coordinate-specific or sample-specific rules.

interaction.initial_selection: Opening a Google road panorama automatically runs its current view.
interaction.camera_change: Moving forward, changing panorama, rotating or zooming immediately invalidates and clears the old overlay.
interaction.rerun: Run this view processes the newly visible frame and displays only a matching frame result.
interaction.stale_response: A response whose frame_id or revision no longer matches the visible panorama is discarded.

acceptance.completion_rule: A successful result requires actual model execution on the exact requested image; stale and substituted results must be rejected.
